rows.grounds: optative of vidhā, 'to make or arrange'; third person singular active
instrumental singular of the compound measure navahasta, 'nine hands'
compound adjective joining vistāra, 'breadth', and āyāma, 'length', with saṃyuta, 'endowed with'

items.question: What measure should one use to make the form endowed with breadth and length?
items.inference: The form is to be made with breadth and length measured by nine hands.
uncertainties: The object of vidadhyāt is not explicit in this verse.
items.plain_english: One should make it endowed with breadth and length, using nine hands as the measure.
